\section*{Detection under the definition common to both systems}
\label{sec:supp-definitions}

Reported under deviation D12. The registration reports under the definition of a session common to both systems (\texttt{all}, every session) only whether it holds the same sessions as the definition of the cell's system. For a cell in which it did not, the detection of the primary comparison pooled over the strata is given under both definitions, with Wilson intervals, which for pooled proportions are lower bounds of the uncertainty, together with the range of the per-stratum Wilson intervals of recall and precision over the strata that keep at least 30 trials in the scope and have a value, as in the main text. A pooled value is not an estimate for natural typing.

The two definitions held the same sessions in the cell macOS, live conversion off and in the cell macOS, live conversion on.
